scope: Biophysical transport / pharmacology model of KPV (Lys-Pro-Val) influx through GSDMD pyroptotic pores vs. the constitutive PepT1 (SLC15A1) uptake route. Parameters are diffusion coefficients, pore geometry, Michaelis-Menten transporter kinetics, macrophage geometry, and an extracellular cell-assay effective-concentration proxy.
natural_product_scope_rationale: This is a biophysics/pharmacology scope. Load-bearing parameters come from cryo-EM/AFM structural biology (GSDMD pore), radiolabeled-substrate transporter kinetics (PepT1), and NF-kB reporter cell assays (KPV). None of these belong to a natural-product / TCM / Kampo traditional-use literature, so the traditional-formula-name + species-name + traditional-pathology query matrix (CLAUDE.md global-multilingual discipline) does NOT apply. The multilingual default was still honored at the source level: the KPV and GSDMD primary literature is English-language international-journal work (several groups are China-based but publish in English), and no non-English source was found to carry a divergent load-bearing value.

framings.rationale: Western mechanism/structure literature is the correct and only substantial evidence base for pore geometry, transporter kinetics, and KPV cell-assay potency.
